summary: The candidate is test-only hardening. The recorded base already contains the production ROCm Triton imports and guarded PyTorch fallbacks that fix the original missing top-k callable. The candidate's focused regression and independent adversarial GPU cases passed.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit 2a22c55e25a978d621fc3627d8ba4dd715edeef4, both the live ROCm Triton renormalizer test and forced-missing-optional-kernel DSPARK builder regression passed (2 tests).

Independent randomized comparisons covered dense and sparse paths, live Triton and forced fallback implementations, top-k boundaries 1/2/17/vocabulary/above-vocabulary, and top-p 0.01/0.5/0.9/0.999/1.0. All matched an independent PyTorch reference with maximum absolute error <= 1.49e-08.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015. Both historical failure and candidate validation executed on GPU 0.

remaining_limitations: Kimi-K3 and RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark weights were unavailable. The environment has one MI355X rather than eight MI350X GPUs, so TP8/full-model startup, HTTP serving, semantic accuracy, long-run behavior, and distributed execution remain unverified. Candidate changes are Python tests/reports only; no native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
